tikicchakasutta:
[Tikicchaka+sutta]  CL=10 The Discourse on the Physician, a sutta where the Buddha teaches using the analogy of a physician"s purgative medicine:
'Monks, just as physicians administer purgative medicine to cure diseases caused by bile, phlegm, and wind, which may or may not be effective, so too:
One with right view eliminates wrong view,
One with right intention eliminates wrong intention,
One with right speech eliminates wrong speech,
One with right action eliminates wrong action,
One with right livelihood eliminates wrong livelihood,
One with right effort eliminates wrong effort,
One with right mindfulness eliminates wrong mindfulness,
One with right concentration eliminates wrong concentration,
One with right knowledge eliminates wrong knowledge,
One with right liberation eliminates wrong liberation.
This noble purgative of the Dhamma removes faults (dosa) and leads to freedom from:
1. Rebirth
2. Aging
3. Death
4. Sorrow
5. Lamentation
6. Physical suffering
7. Mental suffering
8. Intense weariness
This is what the Buddha taught to the monks in this discourse.'

titthiyasamādāna: [Titthiya+samādāna] (na) CL=7 (The moral code) which is observed by Titthi well.
titthiyasattha: [Titthiya+sattha] (na) CL=7 The Book of the Titthi that (was named Lokāyata).
titthiyasaññī: [Titthiya+saññā+ī] (ti) CL=7 The perception that can know one who is a Titthi, One who thinks as a Titthi.
titthiyaseyyā: [Titthiya+seyyā] (thī) CL=7 The monastery (which is the place of the bed of ) Titthi.
titthiyasāvaka: [Titthiya+sāvaka] (pu) CL=7 The disciple of  Titthi, One who imitates and practises the practice of  Titthi, The four articles Donor who always offers to Titthi.
titthiyasāvakapariyosāna: [Titthiyasāvaka+pariyosāna] (ti) CL=7 It has the end that is the disciple of  Titthi.

titthiyānubandhana: [Titthiya+anubandhana] (na) CL=7 The Titthi who always follows back Lord Buddha.
titthābhimukha: [Tittha+abhimukha] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī titthābhimukhī] One who faces towards the port.
titthābhiseka: [Tittha+abhiseka] (pu) CL=7 Pouring the water in riverside bathing place, Showering.
titthārāma: [Titthi+ārāma] (pu) CL=7 The monastery of Titthi Takkata which was named Giri.
titthārāmaduvāra: [Titthārāma+duvāra] (na) CL=7 The gate of the monastery (a place such as a building) of Titthitakkatvana which was named Giri.
titthāyatana: [Tittha+āyatana] (na) CL=7 [Titthi+āyatana. Titthañca taṃ anatthānañca āyatananti titthāyatanaṃ, titthiyānaṃ vā sañjātidesaṭṭhena nivāsaṭṭhānaṭṭhena ca āyatanantipi titthāyatanaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 295. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 140. Dvāsaṭṭhidiṭṭhisaṅkhātaṃ titthameva āyatananti titthāyatanaṃ, titthaṃ vā etesaṃ atthīti titthino, titthiyā, tesaṃ āyatanantipi titthāyatanaṃ. Āyatanananti ca...sañjātiṭṭhānaṃ...samosaraṇaṭṭhānaṃ...kāraṇaṃ, taṃ idha sabbampi labbhati....titthīnaṃ āyatanantipi titthāyatanaṃ. Sārattha, 3. 236-7. Diṭṭhisaṅkhātatitthameva āyatanaṃ dukkhuppattiṭṭhānanti titthāyatanaṃ. Vimati, 2. 105.] (1) It is the basis cause which is the place of the wrong doctrine. (2) (A) It is basis cause of happen  Titthi which is (Heresy = the wrong doctrine). (B) The monastery where lives Titthi (The place of Titthi). (C) Titthi Sāsanā which is established by Titthi.
titthāyatanasaṅkanta: [Titthāyatana+saṅkanta] (ti) CL=7 One who transfers and believes the wrong doctrine which is the nonbenefit place.
titthāyatanasutta: [Titthāyatana+sutta] (na) CL=7 Titthāyatana-sutta. A sutta that preaches about three kinds of the wrong doctrine which are People, Creature suffer pain- (1) Pubbekatahetu = which causes due to the past Kamma that you did. (2) Issaranimmānahetu= which happens due to creation by Bissaṇa Deva, The forever God. (3)Ahetu, Apaccaya = which happens without cause.
titthāyatanasāmika: [Titthāyatana+sāmika] (pu) CL=7 The Master of the wrong doctrine (which is the place of nonbenefit), The Master of the wrong doctrine (which is the place of Titthi), Teacher of Titthi.
titthī: [Tittha+ī] (ti) CL=7 One who has 62 kinds of wrong doctrines (that is like the port). See also - Titthāyatana.

tittibhāva: [Titti+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As one who is satisfied.
tittika: [Titta(1)+ika.(tiktaka-saṃ)] (ti) CL=7 (A bitter creeper of Sponge gourd Luffa pentandra plant) which has a bitter taste.
tittikara: [Titti+kara+a] (ti) CL=7 One who can make to be satisfied. See - Tappetu-(2).
tittipubba: [Titti+pubba] (ti) CL=7 It is satisfied in the past, (Eyes, etc.,) which are satisfied in past.
tittira: [Tara+ira] (ti) CL=7 [Taratismā iro, dvittamittañca, tittiro. Dhāna, ṭī. 625. Titti+ra. Tittiroti titti tappanaṃ etassa atthīti tittiro, assatthiatthe ra-paccayo. See - Tittiriya.
tittirajātaka: [Tittira(1)+jātaka] (na) CL=7 Tittira Jātaka, A story which preaches the related with the aesthetic quality based on Partridge, (A) That is: In the past, Partridge, Monkey, and Elephant three creatures lived together based on a Banyan tree (near a Bayan tree), at that time they are not respected each other, Like that unrespect status has flaws, so the younger two listens and obeys the eldest Partridge"s words (sound) and give respect to the aged person, they reach the three pleasant planes of existence.
tittirapattasadisa: [Tittira(1)+patta+sadisa] (ti) CL=7 It is like the feather of Partridge. See - Tittirapattika.
tittirapattika: [Tittira+patta+ika] (ti) CL=7 It is like the feather of Partridge.
tittiri: [Tara+i] (pu) CL=7 The Partridge. Tittiri(pu) [yadicchānāma]. (A Hermit) who was named Tittiri. See - Tittiriya-(2).
tittiriisi: [Tittiri(2)+isi] (pu) CL=7 (A Hermit) who was named Tittiri. See - Tittiriya-(2).

tittiāvahanta: [Titti+āvahanta] (ti) CL=7 It takes delight and satisfaction.
tittodaka: [Titta(1)+udaka] (na) CL=7 The water which has a bitter taste, The bitter water.
titāla: [Ti+tāla] (na) CL=7 (1) Three times of the length of a palm tree, The height of three palm trees. (Ti) (2) It is as high as three palm trees.
tivagga: [Ti+vagga.(tivagī-saṃ)] (pu) CL=7 (1) All of the sum of three Bhikkhus. (2) 'Vagga' which is a group of three kinds, All of the sum of three kinds or pieces. (Ti) (3) It is an aggregate of three kinds that is 'Vagga'. See also - Tivaggattha.
tivaggasaṅgaha: [Ti+vagga+saṅgaha] (ti) CL=7 (A) It is counted by 3 Vaggas (sum of suttas). (B) It should be counted by 3 Vaggas (sum of suttas). (C) It has counted for 3 kinds of Vagga (sum of suttas). See - Maaū, pārā, say.
tivaggosaṅgaha: [Ti+vagga+saṅgaha] (pu) CL=7 [A makes O, or O. Samāsa  pārā, aṭṭhasā, yo and gaṇṭhi - See also]. Nikāya which has three kinds of Vagga (which should be counted).
tivakkabrāhmaṇagāma: [Tivakkabrāhmaṇa+gāma] (pu) CL=7 The Brahmin village which was named Tivakka.
tivaranāmaka: [Tivarā+nāma+ka] (ti) CL=7 (City, etc.,) which was named Tivara.

tivassantara: [Tivassa+antara] (na) CL=7 Within three years of monkhood. See also - Tivassantara. Tivassantara(ti) [tivassantara+ṇa. Tivassantarikakathāyaṃ tīṇivassāna tivassaṃ, tīṇivā vassāni tivassāni, tivassānaṃ antaraṃtivassantaraṃ, tivassantare ṭhitoti tivassantaro, tena tivassantarena, antarasaddo majjhatthavācako, ṇa-paccayoṭhitatthe. tivassikadāraka: [Tivassika+dāraka] (pu) CL=7 A child who is three years old, Three years Baby.

tivattagata: [Tivatta(=ti+vā+tta)+gata] (ti) CL=7 It reaches the state of being three kinds.

tividhasetacchatta: [Tividha+seta+chatta] (na) CL=7 The white umbrella which has three kinds (that are People, Deva and Arahattaphala).
tividhasīlapāripūrī: [Tividhasīla+pāripūrī] (thī) CL=7 Fulfilled with precepts (by Sampattavirati, Samādānaviratī and Samucchedavirati).

tivutālatā: [Tivutā+latā] (thī) CL=7 The creeper of Moon flower Ipomaea bona-nox (plant). See also - Caturassavalli.

They are without attached to the ornament and garments of north island women, do not take a woman (not fond of women and do not get married), has a special quality that is 1000 years long living. It is overcome and being superior to Tāvatiṃsā Deva and females in Jambūdipa Island by those three factors.
